# PHP QR Code

This directory includes `phpqrcode.php` from PHP QR Code 1.1.4.

- Upstream: http://phpqrcode.sourceforge.net/
- Copyright: Dominik Dzienia and contributors
- License: LGPL-3.0-or-later (full text: `LICENSE`)

It is used locally to generate TOTP QR codes; no secret is sent to a third-party service.
